en: A grey postcard with a dark, stylized artwork on the front showing an abstract night scene: a crescent moon, a large arc, three vertical pillars, and a rectangular field with many small vertical elements, possibly representing a memorial or grave markers. Behind it lies a grey envelope with blue printed sender information and white handwritten recipient information in Estonian, plus a circular postmark and postage imprint from Tallinn.
